headline: Wildcard IAM permissions policy grants the deploy role unrestricted access to all AWS resources

findings.evidence_ref: The policy in aws_iam_role_policy.deploy grants Action: "*" and Resource: "*", giving the role permission to perform any action on any resource in the AWS account
findings.explanation: This policy grants the CodeBuild deployment role full AWS permissions with no restrictions. Even constrained to CodeBuild execution, this violates the principle of least privilege and creates a significant attack surface if the role is compromised or misused in the pipeline.
